paras.text: Body paragraphs: Body paragraphs is the area where you provide arguments and provide evidence to prove your point and thus to persuade the readers. The best way here ,is to present one point in one paragraph. At least, three body paragraphs would make a good persuasive essay.
paras.urdu: متن کے پیراگراف: متن کے پیراگراف وہ حصہ ہیں جہاں آپ اپنا نکتہ ثابت کرنے اور یوں قارئین کو قائل کرنے کے لیے دلائل اور شواہد پیش کرتے ہیں۔ یہاں بہترین طریقہ یہ ہے کہ ایک پیراگراف میں ایک نکتہ پیش کیا جائے۔ کم از کم تین متن کے پیراگراف ایک اچھا ترغیبی مضمون بنائیں گے۔
paras.pashto: د متن پراګرافونه: د متن پراګرافونه هغه برخه ده چې پکې د خپل ټکي د ثابتولو او په دې توګه د لوستونکو د قانع کولو لپاره دلیلونه او شواهد وړاندې کوئ. دلته تر ټولو غوره لاره دا ده چې په یوه پراګراف کې یو ټکی وړاندې کړئ. لږ تر لږه درې د متن پراګرافونه به یوه ښه هڅوونکې مقاله جوړه کړي.

paras.text: Conclusion: It where you would conclude your essay. Here, you have to summarize and close the essay with an impact. You will try to convince the reader claiming that your argument is the most valid one.
paras.urdu: اختتامیہ: یہ وہ جگہ ہے جہاں آپ اپنا مضمون ختم کریں گے۔ یہاں آپ کو خلاصہ کرنا ہے اور مضمون کو مؤثر انداز میں ختم کرنا ہے۔ آپ یہ دعویٰ کرتے ہوئے قاری کو قائل کرنے کی کوشش کریں گے کہ آپ کی دلیل سب سے زیادہ درست ہے۔
paras.pashto: پایله: دا هغه ځای دی چې خپله مقاله پکې پای ته رسوئ. دلته باید لنډیز وکړئ او مقاله په اغېزمن ډول پای ته ورسوئ. هڅه به وکړئ چې لوستونکی قانع کړئ او ادعا وکړئ چې ستاسو دلیل تر ټولو سم دی.

paras.text: To sum up, a good argumentative essay should have:
paras.urdu: خلاصہ یہ کہ ایک اچھے استدلالی مضمون میں یہ ہونا چاہیے:
paras.pashto: په لنډه توګه، یوه ښه استدلالي مقاله باید ولري:

paras.text: 2- Logical reasoning, examples, evidence,facts and figures etc in support of the thesis statement.
paras.urdu: 2- مرکزی دعوے کی تائید میں منطقی استدلال، مثالیں، شواہد، حقائق اور اعداد و شمار وغیرہ۔

paras.text: 3- An effective conclusion.

sections.theory:
Body paragraphs: Body paragraphs is the area where you provide arguments and provide evidence to prove your point and thus to persuade the readers. The best way here ,is to present one point in one paragraph. At least, three body paragraphs would make a good persuasive essay.

Conclusion: It where you would conclude your essay. Here, you have to summarize and close the essay with an impact. You will try to convince the reader claiming that your argument is the most valid one.

To sum up, a good argumentative essay should have:

1- A clear and solid thesis statement in the introduction.

2- Logical reasoning, examples, evidence,facts and figures etc in support of the thesis statement.

3- An effective conclusion.

Activity

Keeping in view the structure of an argumentative essay, write your own opinion on the following topic : " The bread earner has always got a stronger social status"

Oral Communication

Divide the class into two equal groups. The first group will be asked to speak in favour of women equality and the second group will be asked to speak against it.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Use the bank of prefixes to complete each word. There may be more than one answer for some words. Use new words in your sentences.

B. Complete the sentences with the verb in brackets. Use the First Conditional.

1. If my aunt comes to visit, she ........ (give) us a present.

2. If it doesn't rain, we ........ (go) to the beach.

3. If it ........ (snow) tonight, we will make a snowman tomorrow.

4. If you don't try, you ........ (not succeed).

5. If you ........ (bring) the sandwiches for the picnic, I will bring the drinks.

6. If he talks too long, his parents ........ (not let) him use the phone.

7. He will turn on the heater if it ........ (get) too cold.

8. You won't understand the questions unless you ........ (read) the book.

9. If we ........ (go) to Peshawar, we ........ (visit) my friend Salman.

10. If she ........ (do) well in her exams, my sister ........ (go) to university.

11. Neelam ........ (not eat) supper if she ........ (eat) all that ice cream.

12. My brother ........ (drive) us to the cinema if we ........ (ask) him.

13. Uncle Ismail ........ (phone) us if he ........ (want) to come with us.

C. Circle the correct words.

1. Arif will water the garden if he comes/will come home.

2. We will buy our tickets if we will have/have enough money.

3. We will be late for the show unless you hurry/will hurry.

4. I will take/take an umbrella if it rains.

5. If it is/will be a nice day tomorrow, we will go for a bike ride.

6. He won't cross the road unless he will see/sees the green light.

sections.content:
Body paragraphs: Body paragraphs is the area where you provide arguments and provide evidence to prove your point and thus to persuade the readers. The best way here ,is to present one point in one paragraph. At least, three body paragraphs would make a good persuasive essay.

Conclusion: It where you would conclude your essay. Here, you have to summarize and close the essay with an impact. You will try to convince the reader claiming that your argument is the most valid one.

To sum up, a good argumentative essay should have:

1- A clear and solid thesis statement in the introduction.

2- Logical reasoning, examples, evidence,facts and figures etc in support of the thesis statement.

3- An effective conclusion.

Activity

Keeping in view the structure of an argumentative essay, write your own opinion on the following topic : " The bread earner has always got a stronger social status"

Oral Communication

Divide the class into two equal groups. The first group will be asked to speak in favour of women equality and the second group will be asked to speak against it.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Use the bank of prefixes to complete each word. There may be more than one answer for some words. Use new words in your sentences.

B. Complete the sentences with the verb in brackets. Use the First Conditional.

2. If it doesn't rain, we ........ (go) to the beach.

3. If it ........ (snow) tonight, we will make a snowman tomorrow.

5. If you ........ (bring) the sandwiches for the picnic, I will bring the drinks.

6. If he talks too long, his parents ........ (not let) him use the phone.

7. He will turn on the heater if it ........ (get) too cold.

8. You won't understand the questions unless you ........ (read) the book.

9. If we ........ (go) to Peshawar, we ........ (visit) my friend Salman.

10. If she ........ (do) well in her exams, my sister ........ (go) to university.

11. Neelam ........ (not eat) supper if she ........ (eat) all that ice cream.

12. My brother ........ (drive) us to the cinema if we ........ (ask) him.

13. Uncle Ismail ........ (phone) us if he ........ (want) to come with us.
